ZAF.note: Only smart ID applications at bank branches; no authentication service stated.
The document does not mention the civil register.
Gives cards processed through FNB branches, not people enrolled.
The document says nothing about numbers at birth.
Describes a bank channel for applications, not who operates the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is named.

facts.fact: Home Affairs is issuing smart ID cards to replace green bar-coded ID books; more than 14,000 have been issued under FNB's new digital model and more than half a million South Africans have switched through bank partnerships in under five months, per the minister.
